## Broken link checker

Once a day the workflow visits the destination of every active kua.lat link and emails you the ones that no longer respond correctly — timeouts, dead domains, 404s and the like.

When everything is healthy, no email is sent.

**Set up:**
1. Install the **@kualat/n8n-nodes-kualat** community node under Settings → Community Nodes.
2. Create a **Kualat API** credential (API URL, for example `https://kua.lat/api`, and an API key).
3. Connect a Gmail credential and set the recipient on the **Send Report** node.
4. With more than 100 links, raise the limit on **Get Links** or turn on Return All.
5. Activate the workflow.
